programme.title: Can You Keep a Secret?
programme.desc: I den tro at de er ved at styrte ned, fortæller Emma alle sine hemmeligheder til en flot, men vildfremmed mand om bord på et fly. Det vil sige, hun troede, at han var fremmed… Filmen er baseret på bestsellerromanen af samme navn fra Sophie Kinsella.

programme.title: Demain tout commence
programme.desc: Samuel nyder et sorgløst liv på Den Franske Riviera, indtil Kristin, som han har haft en kortvarig affære med, meddeler, at han er far til et nyfødt barn, overlader en lille pige til ham og stikker af!

programme.title: Det Handler Om Henry
programme.desc: Henry er en succesrig advokat, der altid vil vinde, også selvom det går ud over familien. Et enkelt skud sætter dog en stopper for Henrys karriere og efterlader ham ude af stand til at tage vare på sig selv og uden erindring om livet, han levede før.

programme.title: The Country Girl

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Lauded as “The Mecca of Paranormal Investigation”, Waverly Hills is purportedly home to spirits who are not shy to interact with visitors who frequent its massive halls, with decades’ worth of inexplicable finds documented by various investigators.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: One of Tennessee''s most respected thoroughbred horse farms, the Rose Mont was built by Judge "Jo" Conn Guild, where his family resided for generations. Today, it operates as a wedding and event venue where guests have claimed to spot apparitions.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Joan Rivers, David Carradine, Scott Baio, Teri Polo
programme.desc: Joan Rivers asks a voodoo priestess to help her with an angry ghost.

programme.desc: When Barry Williams holds a memorial service for his father, a few strange "happenings" make the day even more unforgettable; Debi Mazer gets a hostile welcome from a ghost when she moves into a friend's home.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksassistent støder på en mystisk plante med sult efter blod. Succes følger, men prisen viser sig at være menneskeliv, og situationen eskalerer.

programme.title: The Cider House Rules
programme.desc: Den Oscar®-vindende publikumsfavorit om en mand, der søger efter et tilhørssted. Filmatiseret af bestsellerromanen, John Irvings stærke lektion om livet, kærlighed og hjemmet fik ros af kritikere og biografgæster over alt.

programme.title: My Best Friend's Girl
programme.desc: Tank (Dane Cook) står over for den ultimative venskabsprøve, da hans bedste ven (Jason Biggs) hyrer ham til at tage hans eks (Kate Hudson) med på en skidt date for at få hende til at indse, hvor god en kæreste han er.

programme.title: Ernest Goes to School
programme.desc: Jim Varneys tilbagevendende tumpede karakter Ernest P. Worrell vender tilbage i denne film som en pedel, der prøver at komme igennem high school. Bemærk denne film vises uden undertekster.

programme.title: Ghost Town
programme.desc: Den muntre, romantiske komedie Ghost Town er historien om Bertram Pincus, en vred tandlæge fra Manhattan, der udvikler en uønsket evne til at se afdøde mennesker.

programme.title: A Breath Of Scandal
programme.desc: Den smukke Sophia Loren er den østrigske prinsesse, der trods sin eksil fra familiens ejendom foragter sin mors ønske om at gifte sig med en prins.

programme.title: Jeg hedder stadig Trinity
programme.desc: Verdens populæreste spaghettihelte, Terence Hill og Bud Spencer er denne gang meget mod deres vilje kommet til at optræde som tapre mænd.

programme.title: Setup
programme.desc: De tre venner Vincent, Sonny og Dave planlægger et stort diamantkup. Men Vincent har brug for alle pengene selv og skyder de to andre. Dog overlever Sonny og vil have hævn.

programme.title: Taken
programme.desc: Den tidligere regeringsagent Bryan Mills står over for sit livs længste 96 timer – jagten på den frygtindgydende organisation, der har taget hans datter.

programme.title: Gasoline Alley
programme.desc: Den rehabiliterede forbryder Jimmy Jayne er den hovedmistænkte i en brutal Hollywood-mordsag og vil gøre alt for at bevise sin uskyld.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Faux Fox
programme.desc: Da Nigel bliver charmeret af den geniale studerende Lorraine til at vise hende deres kontorer (og kysse), slår en indbrudstyv Sidney ud, men hvad blev der stjålet?

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Pandoras æske
programme.desc: Sidney arver en nøgle fra den bedste relikviejæger fra den foregående generation og tager sammen med Nigel på jagt efter den eneste skat, han aldrig fandt: Pandoras æske.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Krigsherren
programme.desc: Bekkastan, 1401 e.Kr.: Krigerprinsesse Kahina beviser sin ret til at regere. 2002: Sydney og Nigel finder et hulemaleri, der kan føre dem til Kahinas sadel.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Besætningen skal stoppe en verdens skibsbygger, før han starter en ny invasion

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1987 the New Mexico Penitentiary housed hundreds of violent offenders, rapists, killers, men the juries put behind bars to protect society. On July fourth, seven of those men escaped.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Kids! Wadaya Gonna Do?
programme.desc: In need of cold cash for hot prospects, Bud and Kelly find creative ways to earn money, while a disgruntled Peg shares an uneventful evening of videos with Al and the D'Arcys.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Route 666 - Part I

programme.title: Vore værste år: Route 666 - Part II
programme.desc: The California Coast will have wait when, stranded in a ghost town, the Bundys and the D'Arcys catch "gold fever" and become wary mining partners.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Buck The Stud

programme.title: RENO 911!: Coconut Nut Clusters

programme.title: RENO 911!: Death of a Pickle-Thrower

programme.title: The Roast of Charlie Sheen

programme.title: Jeff Ross Roasts Criminals

programme.title: Jeff Ross Presents: Roast Battle II
programme.desc: Jeff Ross tager på turné som vært for Roast Battle i amerikanske byer. Der er kendte gæstedommere, deltagerne går på scenen og prøver at overgå hinanden i grovheder for at vinde mesterskabsbæltet.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Carrie Fisher, Rue McClanahan, John Waters, Federico Castelluccio
programme.desc: Carrie Fisher has a spooky experience after her best friend dies in her bed; John Waters still remembers a scary night in the woods back in the 1950s.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Tom Arnold, Dee Snider, Carnie Wilson, Nia Long
programme.desc: Tom Arnold takes his teenage anger out on a pipe organ, angering a revengeful spirit; Dee Snider's murdered brother-in-law has a message from the grave.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Kendra Wilkinson
programme.desc: Kendra Wilkinson (The Girls Next Door, Kendra on Top) is desperate to know what or who was behind the paranormal encounters she had at her former home in Pasadena, CA.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Jordan Ladd
programme.desc: Actress Jordan Ladd (Cabin Fever, Grindhouse) anxiously returns to an old mansion in New Jersey where she once encountered a ghost as it was watching her sleep.

programme.title: Dark Star DA
programme.desc: Vi er i midten af det 21. århundarede, og mennesket har udforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forladt Jorden for at finde nye hjem i universet. Det bevæbnede rumskib "Dark Star" skal bane vej for alle disse fredelige kolonister.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Efter næsten at have mistet livet i “Daredevil” er superheltinden ELEKTRA tilbage i en verden af drab og bedrag – stærkere, smukkere og smidigere end før, men...

programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: Advokat MattMurdock er blind, men hans resterende fire sanser er overmenneskelige skarpe. Om dagen repræsenterer Murdock de undertrykte, men om natten er han.

programme.title: Barbershop: The Next Cut
programme.desc: It's been more than 10 years since our last appointment at Calvin's Barbershop. Ice Cube, Cedric the Entertainer and the whole crew are back together for a quick trim, some good conversation, a little gossip...and to save their neighborhood!

programme.title: Fårfejden
programme.desc: Colin og Les opdrætter prisvindende får på en gård i et lille australsk samfund. Da en sygdom spreder sig blandt dyrene, og myndighederne beslutter, at alle fårene i dalen skal aflives, må mændene arbejde sammen for at redde deres levebrød.

programme.title: Blue Hawaii
programme.desc: Hans mor (Angela Lansbury) forventer, at han avancerer i sin karriere. Men Elvis vil hellere gå med en aloha-skjorte end jakkesæt, så han tager arbejde som rejseleder. Heldige Elvis: hans første kunder er en bil fuld af søde piger.

programme.title: Wim Wenders Collection: Paris, Texas
programme.desc: ‘Paris, Texas’ er formentlig Wim wenders’ mest kendte og succesfulde film. Filmen fortæller historien om Travis, en mand der er fortabt i sit eget private helvede. Travis har været formodet død i flere år, men dukker op ved Mexicos grænse

programme.title: While We're Young
programme.desc: New Yorker-parret Josh og Cornelia er begge i 40’erne. Alderskrisen kradser, så da de møder et ungt hipster-par, Jamie og Darby, skiftes parmiddage ud med rulleskøjter, jazzhat og hip-hop-timer.

programme.title: Till Death
programme.desc: Efter en romantisk aften i deres afsides hus vågner Emma lænket til sin døde mand. Hun er fanget, afskåret fra omverdenen og må kæmpe mod lejemordere for at undslippe sin mands forskruede plan.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Dylan bliver kidnappet af nietzscheanere og tvunget til at spille tankespil til sin fangevogteres fornøjelse.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: To nietzscheanske søskende er i et opgør om et våben, der kan eliminere højere hjernefunktioner.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Tyr vender tilbage efter at have sluttet sig til samlerne og forlanger at få sin tidligere besætningskammerat til at vise ham vejen gennem tiderne.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Ungdommens springvand
programme.desc: Mens Nigel øver sin tale på et hotelværelse i Sevilla, er en pige tæt på at brække hans næse og forlange noget - det viser sig, at hun var ude efter vandet fra Ungdommens Kilde.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Arthurs kors
programme.desc: Scotland Yard indkalder Sidney og Nigel for at identificere et mordvåben fra det 5. århundrede.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Target

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Illeana Douglas
programme.desc: Actress Illeana Douglas (Goodfellas, Six Feet Under, Entourage) wants to know who or what was behind the paranormal encounters she had at her former apartment in New York City.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Johnny Weir
programme.desc: Secrets are revealed when Olympic Ice skater Johnny Weir finally crosses the threshold of the ominous brick building that has petrified him since his childhood in Pennsylvania.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Drakelow Tunnels
programme.desc: The Drakelow Tunnels are a former underground military complexused mainly for storage. However, during the construction and running of this facility, 6 people are thought to have died.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Razor Ruddock's Home
programme.desc: We visit the home of Soccer legend Neil "Razor" Ruddock which seems to be haunted. Is it his home specifically? Or are these ghosts attached to him?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Blackpool Pleasure Beach
programme.desc: Blackpool Pleasure Beach is one of the most visited attractions in the United Kingdom. People visit it not only for the fun, but to also hopefully catch a glimpse of the many ghosts that haunt there.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: Legend: Director's Cut
programme.desc: I en eventyrskov med feer, nisser, enhjørninger ogdødelige bor også den mystiske skovbo, derer udset til at redde den smukke prinsesse ogbesejre mørkets onde fyrste…

programme.title: Blue Chips
programme.desc: College-basketballtræneren Pete Bell er under pres. Hans hold vinder ikke. Fremtidens stjerner bliver betalt af andre hold. Efterhånden som presset vokser, tager desperate Pete lyssky midler i brug.

programme.title: The Way Way Back
programme.desc: 1941, syv krigsfanger flygter fra den frygtelige sovjetisk Gulag-lejr. Igennem 11 måneder kæmper de sig over 6.500 km fra Sibirien over den glohede Gobi-ørken i Mongoliet og videre over Himalaya bjergene.
En kræftpatient (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) overvinder alle odds med hjælp fra sin bedste ven (Seth Rogen), sin mor (Anjelica Huston) og en ung terapeut (Anna Kendrick).

programme.title: Double Jeopardy (1955)
programme.desc: En ejendomsmægler bliver tiltalt for et mord, han ikke har begået, og han beslutter sig for at bevise, at han er uskyldig.

programme.title: Notorious
programme.desc: Datteren af en dømt nazistisk spion bliver bedt af amerikanske agenter om at indsamle oplysninger om en ring af nazistiske videnskabsmænd i Sydamerika. Hvor langt skal hun gå for at infiltrere dem?

programme.title: The Place Beyond the Pines
programme.desc: En motorcyklist påbegynder et liv med kriminalitet for at kunne forsørge sønnen, som han ikke vidste, han havde. Han bliver i mellemtiden forfulgt af en idealistisk politimand.

programme.title: Sweet Carolina

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: Jungle
programme.desc: Daniel Radcliffe kjemper mot naturens brutale krefter og sitt eget sinn mens han prøver å overleve i Bolivias uforsonlige jungel.

programme.title: The One I Love
programme.desc: Et par i krise prøver å redde forholdet sitt på en helgetur.

programme.title: Ghost Town
programme.desc: En spirituell romantisk komedie, Ghost Town er historien om Bertram Pincus, en gretten tannlege på Manhattan som utvikler den uønskede evnen til å se døde folk.

programme.title: 10 Items or Less
programme.desc: En kjent skuespiller, som ikke har takket ja til en rolle på fire år, vurderer nå en jobb. Regissørens kusine kjører ham ut av byen til en ranch hvor han vil drive research. På dette idylliske lille stedet blir han helt betatt av en av kassadamene.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Etter å ha bodd i Afrika har Cady ingen anelse om hvor 'vilt' ting kan bli i sivilisasjonen før hun møter en av de slemmeste artene som finnes, 'Dronningbien', som på denne skolen er den kule og kalkulerende Regina George.

programme.title: Hot Seat
programme.desc: IT-eksperten Friar finner en bombe festet til stolen sin, og en hacker beordrer ham til å stjele digitale penger. Snart må Friar kjempe for å renvaske navnet sitt - uten å bli sprengt i fillebiter.

programme.title: Hjemme i Hampstead
programme.desc: En amerikansk enke i London innleder et forhold til en mann som oppholder seg i Hampstead Heath, men en hensynsløs entreprenør vil få ham vekk derfra.

programme.title: American Siege
programme.desc: Den avdankede sheriffen i en liten by i Georgia, Ben Watts, blir presset til raskt å løse en gisselsituasjon – og innser snart at han er en brikke i et større spill blant byens skumle hemmeligheter.

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: Libby Parsons, who discovers that the husband she’s convicted of murdering staged his own “death” and framed her for the crime. Released on parole, she skips town to find him–and that puts parole officer Travis Lehman on her trail.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butikkmedarbeider oppdager en mystisk plante med en blodtørstig appetitt. Suksess følger, men prisen viser seg å være menneskeliv, og situasjonen eskalerer.

programme.title: Disaster Movie
programme.desc: DISASTER MOVIE fortsetter den komiske nedturen til din yndlingsgruppe med latterlig attraktive 20-åringer. En skjebnesvanger natt prøver de å komme seg i trygghet mens enhver kjent naturkatastrofe, knuser byen og deres vei.

programme.title: Mutant X: The Assault
programme.desc: Mange av mysteriene rundt Mutant X blir avslørt når Lexa og Jesse blir fanget av Dominion, og teamet, sammen med Adam, går inn for å redde dem.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Fountain of Youth
programme.desc: Mens Nigel øver sin hovedtale på et hotellrom i Sevilla, knekker en jente nesten nesen og krever noe - det viser seg at hun var ute etter vannet fra Fountain of Youth.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Arthur's Cross
programme.desc: Scotland Yard kaller Sidney og Nigel for å identifisere et drapsvåpen fra 500-tallet. Det viser seg å være gravkorset til King Arthur, men i tillegg til offeret leter flere andre etter det.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: So Shall It Be
programme.desc: Når Sidney og Nigel er i ferd med å gå inn på stedet for en Bristol-foredrag, nærmer en ung forfatter dem å følge opp et øyeblikkelig tips om et kart til de tapte nøklene til druidekulten i Stonehenge.

programme.title: Andromeda: Under natten
programme.desc: Etter å ha blitt igjen strandet i nærheten av et svart hull, blir kaptein Dylan Hunt oppdaget av et leiesoldat bergingsskip og finner at han har vært frossen i tide i 300 år.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dead Run
programme.desc: In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: The FBI Files: First and Kennedy Street Crew
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: Dark Star NO
programme.desc: Det er midten av 2000-tallet, og mennesket har utforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forlatt jorden for å finne nye hjem i universet. Det væpnede romskipet "Dark Star" skal bane vei for alle de fredelige kolonistene.

programme.title: Two Lovers
programme.desc: En ung mann står overfor en kompleks kjærlighetstrekant når han navigerer mellom to svært ulike kvinner.

programme.title: The Queen Of Spain
programme.desc: I denne dramakomedien går Oscar-vinneren Penélope Cruz atter en gang sammen med den prisvinnende regissøren/forfatteren Fernando Trueba, denne gang for å lage oppfølgeren til filmen deres fra 1998, The Girl of Your Dreams.

programme.title: Vekk Ikke Musen Som Sover
programme.desc: Brødrene Lars og Ernie Smuntz er forfulgt av uflaks og har liten tro på den gamle herregården de arver, helt til de oppdager at den forfalne eiendommen egentlig er verdt millioner.

programme.title: What Happens In Vegas
programme.desc: Etter en ekstremt fuktig kveld på byen våkner to svært forskjellige fremmede opp på et hotellrom. Jack og Joy har begge fått en ektefelle og masse penger de ikke hadde dagen før! Med Ashton Kutcher og Cameron Diaz.

programme.title: Parker
programme.desc: En kompromissløs mestertyv blir forrådt av medhjelperne og overlatt for å dø. Han utgir seg for å være en annen og samarbeider med en kvinne på innsiden for å sikre seg det seneste kuppet til gjengen.

programme.title: 97 Minutes
programme.desc: Et kapret fly vil styrte om bare 97 minutter når det går tom for drivstoff. NSA-direktøren vil at flyet skal skytes ned før den tid, og overlater skjebnen til de uskyldige passasjerene til en hemmelig Interpol-agent.

programme.title: Pumping Iron
programme.desc: Arnold Schwarzenegger og Lou Ferrigno møter hverandre i en intens konkurranse om Mr. Olympia-tittelen i denne kritikerroste filmen som gjorde Schwarzenegger berømt.

programme.title: Coneheads
programme.desc: Ett blikk, og du vet at de er fra et veldig rart sted. De er fra New Jersey, via "Frankrike", via Remulak langt ute på viddene. De er Coneheads.

programme.title: Cold War
programme.desc: En lidenskapelig kjærlighetshistorie mellom to personer med forskjellig bakgrunn og temperament, på tross av at de er en dårlig match klarer de ikke å gi slipp på hverandre.

programme.title: Andromeda: En bekreftende flamme
programme.desc: Dylan beskytter Andromeda mot leiesoldater mens Beka begynner å lure på om de kjemper for feil side.

programme.title: Andromeda: Å miste den skjebnesvangre lynet
programme.desc: Dylan finner en romstasjon full av barn som tror at han er der for å bringe fred ved å drepe fiendene sine.

programme.title: Andromeda: D Minus Zero
programme.desc: Andromeda-mannskapet lærer fremdeles hvordan de skal samarbeide ettersom de blir angrepet av restauratørene.

programme.title: Mutant X: I Scream the Body Electric
programme.desc: Brennan blir fanget og faller under Eckharts kontroll, og han blir tvunget til å jobbe mot de nye mutantene.

programme.desc: Drops of blood and a torn screen were all that's left to tell authorities what happened to a woman in Indiana. The 21 yr. old victim was taken from her home on a spring morning. She appeared to have no real enemies, there was no clear motive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: When Seconds Count
programme.desc: On July 2nd 1994, a 12-year-old girl was abducted from her home in northern California. The FBI knows to act fast, search wide, enlist volunteers. But as the hours slipped by, agents also realized their chances for recovering her alive grew slim.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Gas Station Show
programme.desc: When Al can't pay his bill at the gas station, he is forced to don a uniform and work at the station. He spends the day being hounded by motorists, as well as Peg and the kids.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: England Show - Pt 1
programme.desc: Lower Uncton, England 1653-- Seamus McBundy makes the mistake of insulting a witch who casts an evil spell upon the land, shading the town in darkness forever--as long as a male Bundy lives.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: England Show - Pt 2
programme.desc: The Bundys delight in their comped trip to England, spending here and there. All the while, the town of Upper Uncton conspires to kill the Bundys outside Lower Uncton, so the curse will remain and Upper Uncton can still rake in profits as a tourist town.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: England Show - Pt 3
programme.desc: The Bundys are cornered by both towns. Upper Uncton wants them dead so they can continue to profit as a tourist trap while Lower Uncton wants them dead so they can end the curse.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Magnificent Seven
programme.desc: Al is shocked about having another kid when Peggy's relatives leave their five-year-old son Seven in the Bundy home.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: T-R-A-Something-Something Spells Tramp
programme.desc: Kelly has to walk through the wilderness after dumping her boyfriend in the forest. Al and Peg try to 'talk' their marriage alive, but without success. Bud dates a girl with the measles.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Every Bundy Has a Birthday
programme.desc: Peggy discovers that Seven does not know when his birthday is, and the family decides to celebrate him... on Al's birthday.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Al on the Rocks
programme.desc: Al has to take a job as a topless bartender to pay for Seven's doctor bill, but Peggy fears that Bud and Kelly might make Seven sick, and kicks them out of the house.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: What I Did for Love
programme.desc: Peggy tries to make Al more interested in having sex with her by purchasing new dresses, unsuccessfully.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Take a number / Stewart moves away / Premature evacuation
programme.desc: The duo goes to rock concert / Beavis and Butt-Head breaks into Stewarts house to watch TV / A bomb threat is called into their high school

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: A great day / Bride of Butt-Head / Special delivery
programme.desc: The school closes and makes the best day / Butt-Head phones in a mail-order bride / Burger World launches a home delivery service

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: Butt-Head blir snäll / Hemhjälpen
programme.desc: Butt-Head får medicin för sin aggressivitet mot Beavis och blir lite för snäll./ Medelålders Beavis och Butt-Head får slut på ölpengar, så Beavis måste skaffa ett jobb.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Radio Sweethearts / The Great Cornholio
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head win a radio contest and become disc jockeys for a day. / During a sugar rush, Beavis' alter ego appears. He reeks havoc at Highland High looking for "teepee for his bunghole."

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Car Wash / Kidnapped
programme.desc: Beavis & Butt-head attempt to make some money washing cars. / Beavis & Butt-head decide that kidnapping Stewart would be a quick way to some cash.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Woodshop / T.V. Violence / Canned / Garage band
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-Head take woodworking class / Stevensons get a sattelite dish / An unopened can puts our duo to new adventures / Beavis and Butt-Head form a band called Metallica

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Buy Beer / Just For Girls
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head get drunk off non-alcoholic beer and fail a sobriety test. / Beavis and Butt-head are allowed to watch a film for girls about teen pregnancy. The titillation ends abruptly during the birthing sequence.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Nose Bleed / Vaya Con Cornholio
programme.desc: Butt-head tries some sadistic home remedies in an attempt to stop Beavis's nosebleed. / When Beavis turns into Cornholio in Burger World, Immigration Officials take him in as a possible illegal alien and try to make sense of his gibberish.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel's Dad Returns
programme.desc: While the deputies investigate Reno's Thai sex trade, Wiegel's long-lost father returns to reconnect with his daughter.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Junior Runs for Office
programme.desc: Junior finds a job he really wants: commissioner for animal carcass removal.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Undercover Acting Coach
programme.desc: Sergeant Clift, the LAPD's undercover acting coach, teaches the deputies the subtle art of theater.

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Parade
programme.desc: The Carson City Parade Float Contest brings out the deputies' competitive spirit.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Training Day
programme.desc: Jones adjusts to his new partner's unorthodox style, and Wiegel and Williams enjoy some surprisingly delicious racist wines.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Extradition to Thailand!
programme.desc: Junior and Jones reap the benefits that come from extraditing a murderer, and Dangle and Rizzo receive a surprise crash course in surgery.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Digging with the Murderer
programme.desc: Dangle and Williams haggle with a serial killer to get him to reveal where he buried his victims.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Murder Mystery, Pt. 1
programme.desc: Dangle invites the gang to a Reno's Sierra Historical Society dinner -- and a murder.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Murder Mystery, Pt. 2
programme.desc: Who murdered Debbie Dangle, and how does her death tie into the deputies' sordid past?

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Stopover in a Quiet Town (aka Strangers in Town)
programme.desc: Bob and Millie wake up to find they are in a strange town. Everything appears to be props - trees, animals even cars.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Fugitive
programme.desc: Old Ben, who is able to transform himself into anything, tries to help a crippled little girl.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Sixteen-Millimeter Shrine
programme.desc: An aging, former movie star lives and dreams in the past, constantly watching her old movies alone in her room.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: From Agnes - With Love
programme.desc: A computer technician must deal with the queen of all femme fatales: a computer named Agnes who wreaks havoc on his love life.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Young Man's Fancy
programme.desc: When a newlywed couple briefly returns to the groom's childhood home, the ties of the past prove too strong to resist.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Penny For Your Thoughts
programme.desc: Gaining telepathic abilities when his coin lands on its edge bank clerk Hector B. Poole learns about the difference between other people's plans and fantasies.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Howling Man
programme.desc: Seeking refuge from a storm, traveler David Ellington comes upon a bizarre hermitage of monks, who have imprisoned a man who begs for his help. When David confronts the head monk Brother Jerome, he is told that the man is the devil, and David must decide

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Ring-A-Ding Girl
programme.desc: Bunny receives a ring from her fan club in her home town. In the ring she sees the faces of people from her hometown telling her she's needed there so she returns home.

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: Kalla mig Dave
programme.desc: Det är inte för att han är besvärlig, blyg eller klädd i discokläder som Dave Ming Chang sticker ut i New York. Det beror på att han är en utomjording! Närmare bestämt ett utomjordiskt rymdskepp...

programme.title: Youth In Revolt
programme.desc: Gilbert Grape bor i Endora, med sin autistiska lillebror Arnie och sin rörelsehindrade mamma, ger det honom lite tid för ett eget liv. Så en dag kommer Becky till Endora och det uppstår en alldeles speciell vänskap mellan henne och Gilbert.

programme.title: Ghost Town
programme.desc: Ghost Town är en andlig, romantisk komedi som handlar om Bertram Pincus, en sur tandläkare på Manhattan som får den obehagliga förmågan att se döda människor.

programme.title: Judy
programme.desc: 1968 anländer Judy Garland till London för en rad utsålda konserter. Utåt charmar Judy alla med sin värme och karisma, men inuti är hon djupt ärrad av ett liv i rampljuset och en tuff vårdnadstvist.

programme.title: Beautiful Boy
programme.desc: Den framgångsrike journalisten David har alltid försökt ge sin älskade son allt han behöver. Men vare sig David eller Nics mamma Vicki kan hindra sonen från att börja experimentera med crystal meth.

programme.title: Wim Wenders Collection: Far Away So Close
programme.desc: Cassiel är en ängel som vakar över människorna i det återförenade Berlin. Trots att änglarna egentligen inte får ingripa i människornas liv rycker Cassiel in för att rädda en liten flicka som faller ned från en balkong.

programme.title: Mclintock! (Producer'S Cut)
programme.desc: The Duke stars as George Washington McLintock, a defiant cattle baron whose daughter Becky is due home from college. But G.W.'s reunion with his daughter is tempered by the arrival of his wife Katherine, who left him two years earlier.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Voodoo-korset
programme.desc: När två doktorander som är på jakt efter det haitiska Utu-korset försvinner i New Orleans, ger sig Sydney och Nigel ut i Bayou för att hitta dem.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Förlorad kontakt
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel och miljardären Rod Thorson hoppar i fallskärm i Myanmars djungel för att rädda ett team som Thorson har anlitat för att hitta en gammal offerskål.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ett hjärta för falskhet Inramad
programme.desc: Besättningen måste stjäla en juvel som står i centrum för en fejd mellan en Drift-ägare och Than. Beka faller för en säkerhetschef som tidigare var tjuv.

programme.title: Andromeda: Obarmhärtig som solen
programme.desc: Andromeda svarar på ett nödsamtal när ett lastfartyg attackeras.

programme.title: Andromeda: Senaste samtal vid den Trasiga Hammaren
programme.desc: Besättningen letar efter en länge försvunnen ledare för Samväldet som har gömt sig.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise

programme.title: RENO 911!: Secret Santa

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nothing in the Dark
programme.desc: A lonely old woman refuses to leave her apartment for fear of meeting "Mr. Death."

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nick of Time
programme.desc: A pair of newlyweds stopping in a small town are trapped by their own superstition when playing a fortune-telling machine in a local diner.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nightmare at 20,000 Feet
programme.desc: Mr. Wilson believes he sees a gremlin on the wing of the commercial aircraft he is taking back home... from the sanitarium, where he has been committed for six months after a mental breakdown during a similar flight.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Garrity and the Graves
programme.desc: Jared Garrity arrives in the Old West town of Happiness, Arizona, proclaiming he can revive the dead.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Invaders
programme.desc: When a woman investigates a clamor on the roof of her rural house, she discovers a small UFO and little aliens emerging from it. Or so it seems.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Long Live Walter Jameson
programme.desc: Walter Jameson is an excellent history teacher who talks about the past as if he had lived it.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Rip Van Winkle Caper

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Brain Center at Whipple's
programme.desc: A factory CEO replaces human workers with machines.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: Patrick
programme.desc: Sarah Francis är en ung kvinna vars liv är lite rörigt. Det sista hon behöver är någon annan att ta hand om. Ändå har hennes farmor låtit henne ärva en mycket bortskämd hund, Patrick – hennes mops. Säkert hade hon en tanke bakom det?

programme.title: A Midsummer's Hawaiian Dream
programme.desc: I denna parafras på Shakespeares “En midsommarnattsdröm” försöker två gifta antropologprofessorer och deras studenter hitta en helig tiki för att stoppa skövlingen av Hawaiis djungel.

programme.title: Legend of the Demon Cat
programme.desc: Filmen kommer från den BAFTA-prisbelönte regissören Chen Kaige och utspelar sig under Tangdynastin. En demonkatt dyker plötsligt upp och stör friden i staden Chang'an och orsakar en rad märkliga händelser.

programme.title: Teaaching Mrs. Tingle
programme.desc: Leigh Anns (Katie Holmes) drömmar om ett stipendium saboteras när hennes lärare, mrs Tingle, anklagar henne för att ha fuskat. I ett desperat försök att bevisa sin oskuld, konspirerar Leigh Ann för att lära mrs Tingle en läxa.

programme.title: Win A Date With Tad Hamilton!
programme.desc: Rosalee är en idolfixerad småstadsflicka vars dröm blir sann när hon vinner en dejt med Tad Hamilton. Och även om hennes drömmar förverkligas, betyder detta rent kaos för hennes bäste vän.

programme.title: 97 Minutes
programme.desc: Ett kapat flygplan kommer att krascha om bara 97 minuter när bränslet tar slut. NSA-chefen vill att planet ska skjutas ner innan dess och lämnar de oskyldiga passagerarnas öde i händerna på en hemlig Interpol-agent.

programme.title: Cary Grant - Första gången jag såg dig
programme.desc: Bitterljuvt drama om hopp och förtvivlan

programme.title: Andromeda: Alldeles för mänsklig
programme.desc: Dylan, Beka och Trance följer med Rommie för att ta reda på om ett vapen som utvecklas på en planet som misstror AI.

programme.title: Mutant X: Tid i kvadrat
programme.desc: Ashlocke går tillbaka i tiden för att försöka göra sig oövervinnerlig genom att ge något till sitt yngre jag, vilket får Brennan och Shalimar att följa efter honom.

programme.title: Mutant X: Vems skogar är detta?
programme.desc: Teamet beger sig ut i vildmarken för att spåra upp ett mördande odjur som har siktet inställt på vandrare.

programme.title: Mutant X: Framtiden avslöjad
programme.desc: Ashlocke vill desperat hitta ett botemedel mot sin dödliga sjukdom och infiltrerar Fristaden för att utpressa Adam att få tag på motgiftet.

programme.title: Mutant X: Ingen människa lämnas kvar
programme.desc: Ett militärplan skjuts ned bakom fiendens linjer, vilket får teamet att göra ett desperat försök att återfå det hemliga regeringsvapen som finns gömt ombord.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.
